Statement Text: A woman should be free to refuse sex with her husband or partner under any circumstances.
It is important for girls and women to be educated.
A woman should be free to divorce or leave her husband even if he does not wish to end the marriage.
Men and women are equally suitable for all professions.
It is important for women to have more opportunities in politics.
A woman can live a successful life even if she does not marry a man.
Women often exaggerate their accounts of sexual violence in order to take advantage of the situation.
A university education is more important for a boy than for a girl.
Even if a mother is being mistreated by her partner, she should stay for the sake of the children.
When women lose out to men in a fair competition, they like to claim that they have been discriminated against.
Men make better political leaders than women do.
A woman has to have children in order to be fulfilled.
